Class DistanceControl

Namespace
TwinSharp.CNC
Assembly
TwinSharp.dll

Wraps the TF5200 distance control HLI for a single CNC axis. Allows enabling the interface, issuing commands (activate/freeze/deactivate), and reading state and position feedback via ADS variable handles.

Two activation modes are supported:

  • SET_POS mode (ActivateSetPos(double)): the CNC adjusts the axis to hold the workpiece surface at a commanded absolute position.
  • Constant-distance mode (ActivateConstDistance(double)): the CNC maintains a fixed gap between tool and workpiece surface.

The sensor must be wired as Encoder 2 on the axis and configured in TwinCAT. Parameter P-AXIS-00328 must be set to enable the distance control function globally for the axis.

Semaphore handshake: after writing a command, command_semaphor_rw is set to true. The CNC clears it back to false once the command is latched. In debug contexts it is acceptable not to wait for clearance before issuing the next command.

Activates distance control in constant-distance mode. The CNC will maintain a fixed gap of distanceMm mm between tool and workpiece surface.

Activates distance control in SET_POS mode. The CNC will adjust the axis so that the workpiece surface is held at positionMm (absolute, in mm).

Deactivate()

Deactivates distance control. The offset ramps to zero and the state transitions to TurningOff, then automatically to Inactive once the ramp completes.

Dispose()

Performs application-defined tasks associated with freeing, releasing, or resetting unmanaged resources.

public void Dispose()

Enable()

Signals to the CNC that this HLI interface is present. Creates the ADS variable handles on first call — this is where AdsErrorCode 1808 will surface if TF5200 is not configured on the machine or the axis. Must be called once after connect before any distance control commands will be accepted.

public void Enable()

Freeze()

Freezes the current distance control offset. The axis stops tracking the sensor; the last-applied offset remains active. Transitions to Freeze.

public void Freeze()

GetActualOffsetMm()

Reads the position offset currently being applied to the axis by the distance controller, in mm. Zero when inactive. Requires Enable() to have been called first.
